prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create ONE polished, readable Simplified Chinese editorial infographic summarizing our research into a pose reference library and its possible products. Landscape 3:2, high resolution ideally 3000x2000 or larger. This is an information map, not a website screenshot. Warm ivory background, dark charcoal Chinese sans-serif text, muted forest/sage green and restrained dusty-rose status accents, thin tidy arrows, generous white space. Strong headline, three well-separated main columns with a clear left-to-right conceptual flow, small simple original line icons for files/pose/reference inputs/planning. Do not use actual source pose-library images, do not reproduce a source website or GitHub branding, do not add invented photos, charts, performance numbers or products. Prioritize accurate, large legible Chinese typography over decorations. Use exact supplied Chinese text; no gibberish, duplicate sections, cropped text or illegibly tiny footnotes. The main headline should be clearly legible when the image is displayed at laptop width.

Top:
Small eyebrow "POSE / LOOK · 研究 011 · 2026.10.29"
Headline "姿势参考库：资源、能力与产品方向"
Subtitle "我们的理解：参考素材 + 外部生成模型 + 系列创作流程"
A slim row of four factual numeric highlights: "1,439 张姿势原图" / "288 组姿势" / "6 张写真候选" / "5 个扩展方向"

LEFT COLUMN title "01｜我们手里有什么"
Three nested source cards:
Card 1 sage-tinted, status "已取得", heading "姿势原图"
"1,439 张 PNG · 288 组姿势"
"900×1200 · 多数每组 5 个视角"
"已保存本地原图与私有远端备份"
Card 2 rose-tinted, status "仅有预告", heading "衣装参考"
"仅取得 1 张原始预告拼图"
"约 1,000 张是作者预告"
"完整图库与授权尚未确认"
Card 3 neutral, status "已整理", heading "研究资料与本地工作台"
"10 个项目 · 28 份资料快照"
"来源、说明、许可与部分实现"
"网页：浏览、检索、多视角、收藏、方案"

MIDDLE COLUMN title "02｜参考如何产生作用"
Visually organized main flow:
A row of four compact reference-input tokens "人物" "姿势" "服装" "场景"
arrow down to "外部图像模型"
arrow down to "生成候选 → 对照选片 → 系列交付"
Explain the three responsibilities in a clean compact block:
"素材层：表达动作与已有视角"
"模型层：重新生成图片"
"流程层：编镜头、排顺序、记返修"
Two small lines:
"固定：人物、服装、场景、光线"
"变化：动作、景别、视线、顺序"
A distinct evidence card headed "我们的实测｜《庭院午后》"
"6 张写真候选＝3 张新增＋3 张复用"
"虚构成年亚洲女性 · 手机随拍视觉"
"已支持逐张对照、选片、备注、导出"
"仍有景别、脸部、手部与背景偏差"
A small clear label: "网页展示已存结果，尚无实时生图接口"

RIGHT COLUMN title "03｜可扩展的产品目标"
Five stacked product cards with easy-to-read status badges and deliverables:
"主题写真" — "主题 + 六镜头 + 选片方案" — green badge "已有候选"
"穿搭 Lookbook" — "多角度服装展示与细节册" — neutral badge "待验证"
"婚纱造型" — "拍前造型与镜头提案" — dusty-rose badge "分支小样"
"图文故事" — "叙事顺序 + 图片文案" — neutral badge "规划阶段"
"个人品牌" — "头像、半身、封面等版位" — neutral badge "规划阶段"
Under these five cards, a highlighted goal line:
"优先目标：验证一个可复用的系列创作流程"

BOTTOM full-width conclusion band, visually connected to all columns:
Main line "价值目标｜找图更快 · 目标更清楚 · 返修可追踪 · 方案可复用"
Under it, three readable factual boundary lines, still large enough to read:
"能力边界：原库提供静态参考；视频与真实 3D 需额外工具，目前未验证。"
"许可边界：代码与原图分开核对；原图不公开再分发；真人场景需另用适当授权参考。"
"验证方法：记录制作时间、返修次数与复用情况；产品收益仍是待验证假设。"
Very small but readable source footer "依据：已归档原库资料与本地实测记录。"
Ensure the map makes resource availability, actual tested results, and future product goals visibly distinct.
scope: Summary of archived source research, local resource status and generation pilot; future product goals are hypotheses, not proven capabilities.
notes: 未使用或复制原库图片；图中的图标为生成的示意图形。
资源数量和状态依照已归档研究记录，并非本轮重新下载。
信息图不增加写真试验样本数，未生成额外写真、视频或 3D。
本轮仅本地接入，没有远端提交、推送或部署。
